title: Add a subpath export to a library
description: Add a package subpath export (@scope/lib/feature) to an existing workspace library, and optionally declare the package free of module side effects after checking its sources.

project.description: Name of the existing library project that owns the package.json.

name.description: Subpath to export; consumers import @scope/lib/<name> from src/<name>/index.ts.

sideEffects.description: Set to false to declare "sideEffects": false after verifying that no production source file has a side-effect-only import. Omit to leave the manifest's current declaration unchanged.

dryRun.description: Print the planned manifest and source changes without writing.
